summary: Const-qualified local aggregate init (struct/array-of-matrix, later widened by reporter to struct/array of any type) folds the referenced variable's own DECLARATION-time initializer instead of its current value, silently discarding any writes made to it before the const init. Reproduces on main-debug (89e2f98e2) and on every bisectable stable release v1.4.1907..v1.9.2607 (always-repro'd); non-const control on the same shader is correct. Corroborated on Compiler Explorer (dxc_1_6_2112, dxc_trunk).
title: Initializing a const-qualified var of type 'struct/array of (struct/array of) more than one type' with initializer 'init' will ignore any dynamic writes made to 'init' beforehand
